title: Is Mall World benevolent or malevolent?
content: Serious replies only. Only reply if you’re quite certain you’re visiting mall world. Do not reply if this is just a quirky roleplay to you. Is Mall World benevolent or malevolent to you, in your perception and opinion? Or does it seem more neutral, like waking life? Essentially, do these dreams feel like good dreams, bad dreams, or neither? Benevolent: - Good intentions. - The places you find yourself in, and people you meet are generally kind, helpful, welcoming, and safe. - You feel content, curious, joyful, or at peace here. - Mall World wants the best for you. Malevolent: - Bad intentions. - The places you find yourself in, and people you meet are generally inconsiderate, harmful, unwelcoming, and dangerous. - You feel uneasy, afraid, sad, or anxious here. - Mall World wants to hurt or scare you. Neutral: - No clear overarching intentions. - The places you find yourself in, and people you meet are generally unfazed by you, you are more so observing than participating. - You don’t usually feel strong emotions here. - Mall World is just a random setting. Choose which option fits best to you and your experiences. It’s okay if it varies, you can select your general feeling towards it. [View Poll](https://www.reddit.com/poll/1agcf85)
